articles.summary: If you’re undergoing testosterone replacement therapy (or thinking about it), you should be aware of how this treatment will affect your fertility, especially if you wish to have children in the future. TRT and fertility do not generally mix well together — when you introduce synthetic or lab-manufactured testosterone into your body, your brain assumes your natural testosterone levels are adequate.
